Vacancy I.D.: 042704 - Examination Invigilator Part Time Panel - Waterford Campus Contract :  Casual, Part-Time hourly basis during examination periods Salary :  €15.96 per hour gross South East Technological University are currently accepting applications and following the recruitment process a panel of examination invigilators will be formed for the SETU Waterford Campus. This panel may be called on for examination sessions in Semester 1 & 2 (December/January and May), and Repeats (August) as required. Ordinarily, the panel will operate for a period of 2 years, unless exhausted prior to the end date. On behalf of the University, Examination Invigilators are responsible for overseeing the smooth and efficient running of examinations.  The role of Invigilator would suit someone who has the confidence to enforce the University regulations and to deal effectively and promptly with any problems that present themselves during the examination. The Invigilator must ensure that all policies and procedures pertaining to examinations are rigorously adhered to. Invigilators are required to complete various reports and registers. These are kept as the official record of attendance and any events during the examination. Accurate record keeping is therefore essential. New invigilators will receive training and are placed with experienced Invigilators for on the job training. Invigilators are employed on a casual part-time basis during examination periods. NOTE : Current students and/or staff of the University are ineligible to apply. For candidates who are successful in being panelled following the recruitment process, it will be a condition for appointment that they are not beyond the compulsory retirement age relevant to their date of first recruitment to public/civil service. Application Process: Applications must be made through the online recruitment system on SETU’s Vacancies page on the website. Please log onto SETU Vacancies for further details and to apply for this position. Applications will not be accepted by email, any other third-party website or in any other format. Please note the Application Procedure is a TWO-STEP Process Step 1: Applicants are required to complete the Personal Details section on the online application system Step 2: Applicants are also required to download the application form available within the vacancy advert. Please complete this form and return via email to: recruitmentpmss.wd@setu.ie before the closing date for receipt of applications. Application forms sent to any other email address will not be considered. Both steps above need to be performed prior to the closing date and time of the advert in order to submit a valid application. Applications received after the closing date and time will not be accepted. Garda Vetting may be required for particular posts. SETU is an equal opportunities employer. #SETU

Vacancy: 042284- Internal Auditor (Grade VI, Fixed Term - 2 Years) Contract: Fixed Term Salary: Senior Staff Officer salary scale: €58,476 - €71,440 (based on rates effective 1 June 2026) South East Technological University (SETU)   was established on 1 May 2022. The University has a total student population of approximately 18,500 students with campuses in Waterford, Carlow, Wexford and Wicklow. SETU aims to ensure growth in education provision and enhanced research opportunities, as well as transformative community and industry engagement across the South East of Ireland and beyond. The Governing Body of SETU has been established in accordance with the provisions of the Technological Universities Act 2018 and the Higher Education Authority Act 2022. The functions of the Governing Body are identified in the relevant legislation. The University Internal Audit Function derives its authority from the Governing Body via the Audit & Risk Committee. The aim of the Internal Audit Function is to assist the University in accomplishing its strategic objectives by conducting systematic reviews of the effectiveness of controls, risk and governance processes designed by management to meet the strategic, financial and operational objectives of the University. The Internal Audit function is also expected to support colleagues, management and Audit & Risk Committee by providing assurance reports, recommendations, advice and assessments on matters pertaining to governance, control and compliance. All work is subject to quality assurance review, as directed by the Senior Internal Auditor. In order to meet the requirements of the code of governance, and expand the remit of the internal audit function of the University, SETU is seeking to recruit an internal auditor to support the continuous improvement of corporate governance within the University. The main duty of the post is to assist the Senior Internal Auditor to carry out the University internal audit plan, in accordance with the internal audit charter and procedures. SETU is an equal opportunities employer. #SETU
